stories.summary: Sign in with the platform's Cognito credentials through the builder's /sign-in and /auth/callback flow and land on a builds page that shows the signed-in author and an empty build list, refusing non-members, incorrect passwords and unverifiable callbacks without a session or users row

Keep one stable builder account per Cognito subject, visible on the account page and reused on later sign-ins, in the builder's own users table, with no platform database client, connection or credential anywhere in the deployment

Refuse anonymous and expired-session page and API requests before any builder data is returned, and deny a member removed from the skill-builders group within one hour, sending pages to the sign-in entry point with a message and returning JSON 401 and 403 for APIs
